qualifier: ATF6, XBP1, ATF4 and CREB3 chaperone gene activation and beta-cell apoptosis
name: ER stress chaperone gene activation and beta-cell apoptosis
rationale: All members concern the transcriptional arm of the ER unfolded protein response (ATF6, XBP1, ATF4, CREB3) and ER-stress control of pancreatic beta-cell apoptosis, whereas confusables centre on PERK/HRI/GCN2 translational control and mitochondrial UPR.

qualifier: downstream NF-kappaB activation and IL-2 production
name: Downstream antigen receptor signaling to NF-kappaB and IL-2
rationale: Members cover downstream TCR/BCR signaling, NF-kappaB activation, positive TCR regulation and IL-2 output, while confusables emphasize proximal CD3/ZAP-70 events, CD28 costimulation or co-inhibition, and T cell differentiation.

qualifier: ganglioside lysosomal catabolism and GPI anchor synthesis
name: Glycosphingolipid, ganglioside and GPI anchor metabolism with lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members span ganglioside/glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport and lysosomal (HEXA/HEXB/NEU1) degradation plus GPI anchor synthesis, distinguishing them from confusables focused on N-glycosylation, nucleotide sugars and CDG disorders.

qualifier: negative regulation of VEGF-driven endothelial responses
name: Negative regulation of VEGF-driven endothelial sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members all inhibit endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis, migration and VEGF production/signaling in sprouting angiogenesis, unlike confusables featuring positive regulation, Tie2 or VEGFR2 signaling itself.

qualifier: V-ATPase acidification of lysosomal, endosomal and Golgi lumen
name: V-ATPase-mediated organelle lumen acidification and pH regulation
rationale: Members concern proton transport and pH control of lysosome, endosome and Golgi lumens via V-ATPase plus carbonic anhydrase, whereas confusables involve bicarbonate/anion transporters and Na+/H+ exchangers.

qualifier: RAC GTPases activating WAVE-Arp2/3 lamellipodia
name: RAC GTPase activation of WAVE-Arp2/3 lamellipodium formation
rationale: Members are the RAC1/2/3 GTPase cycles and their WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 output driving lamellipodia, distinct from CDC42/RHOG cycles and broader motility/ruffle regulation in confusables.

core: Mitochondrial ribosome biogenesis and RNA modification
qualifier: pseudouridine synthesis
name: RNA pseudouridylation and mitochondrial ribosome assembly and translation
rationale: Members combine pseudouridine synthesis on mRNA, tRNA and rRNA with mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification, mitoribosome assembly and translation, unlike confusables on mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA stability.

qualifier: p16INK4A, p14ARF and TP53 defects evading senescence
name: Cancer evasion of senescence via CDKN2A and TP53 loss
rationale: All members describe cancer-associated p16INK4A, p14ARF or TP53 defects that let cells escape oncogene- or oxidative stress-induced senescence and apoptosis, whereas confusables cover normal senescence, TP53 regulation or RB1 defects.

qualifier: glucuronidation and SLCO/ABCC organic anion transport
name: Bilirubin and xenobiotic glucuronidation and organic anion transport
rationale: Members cover heme-to-bilirubin degradation, UGT1A glucuronidation, SLCO/ABCC2 organic anion transport and their hyperbilirubinemias plus drug ADME, unlike confusables on phase I/sulfonation, bile acid export or organic cation transport.

qualifier: atypical chain linkages, monoubiquitination and Fanconi interstrand crosslink repair
name: Atypical-linkage ubiquitination, monoubiquitination and interstrand crosslink repair
rationale: Members concern E3-mediated K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched chains, monoubiquitination and its reversal, and the Fanconi anemia crosslink repair pathway, which confusables (DUB families, proteasome, ERAD) lack.

qualifier: aquaporin glycerol transport and polyol metabolism
name: Glycerol, polyol and acylglycerol synthesis with aquaporin glycerol transport
rationale: Members cover glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and alditol metabolism, PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis, lysophospholipid hydrolysis and aquaporin glycerol/urea transport, unlike confusables on endocannabinoids, PC synthesis or lipid droplet/lipolysis regulation.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane organization
qualifier: inner-membrane insertion and cristae formation
name: Mitochondrial protein import, membrane insertion and cristae organization
rationale: Members concern import and inner-membrane insertion of mitochondrial proteins together with cristae, outer membrane and fusion organization, unlike confusables on mitochondrial protein processing/degradation or OXPHOS complex assembly.

qualifier: negative regulation
name: Negative regulation of myoblast differentiation and muscle development
rationale: All members inhibit myoblast proliferation/differentiation or muscle tissue/organ development, distinct from confusables on positive myogenesis, satellite cells or muscle atrophy.

qualifier: IL-12/IL-23, IL-17, IL-10-family and IL-1-family cytokines
name: IL-12/IL-23, IL-17, IL-10-family and IL-1-family cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-12-family, IL-17/Th17, IL-10-family (IL-10, IL-20, type III interferon) and IL-1-family (IL-33, IL-36, IL-38) signaling with barrier wound-healing roles, unlike confusables on fungal lectin receptors, IL-15/IL-21 NK cytokines or Th2/IL-6 cytokines.

qualifier: post-entry viral replication, transport and release
name: Host-virus control of viral replication, transport and release
rationale: Members regulate viral genome replication, protein levels, transport and release by host or virus, whereas confusables focus on viral entry or interferon/ISG15 antiviral programs.

qualifier: keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation balance and melanocytes
name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation balance and skin appendage development
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, melanocytes, and hair follicle, sebaceous gland and nail development, unlike confusables on ectodermal placodes or cornified envelope formation.

qualifier: AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes with IL-18
name: AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasome pyroptosis and IL-18 signaling
rationale: Members cover AIM2 and IPAF/NLRC4 inflammasomes, pyroptosis and IL-18 production/signaling, distinct from confusables on CASP4/5 non-canonical or NLRP1/NLRP3 IL-1 inflammasomes.

qualifier: neural progenitor division and neuronal migration
name: Neural progenitor division and neuronal migration in brain development
rationale: Members span neuroblast proliferation and asymmetric division, radial and tangential neuronal migration and regional development of cortex, forebrain, midbrain and cerebellum, unlike confusables on retina or spinal cord development.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Purine nucleotide de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members cover PRPP and de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis, purine salvage and its defects, purine catabolism and thiopurine handling, unlike confusables on pyrimidines or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: ribosome rescue, aggrephagy and stress granules
name: Degradative protein quality control, ribosome rescue, aggrephagy and stress granules
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin/degron-mediated removal of misfolded proteins, ribosome-associated quality control, aggresome/aggrephagy, ERAD regulation and stress granule dynamics, unlike confusables on chaperonin folding and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF hypoxia programs
name: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF hypoxia transcriptional programs
rationale: Members are NFE2L2-regulated gene programs and NFE2L2 control plus HIF oxygen sensing and hypoxic gene regulation, which confusables (p53/mTORC1 metabolism, FOXO, ROS detoxification, ferroptosis) lack in combination.

qualifier: kinase inhibitor resistance
name: Kinase inhibitor-resistant FLT3 mutants
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to specific tyrosine kinase inhibitors, distinct from KIT/PDGFR resistance and FLT3 signaling confusables; the overlapping FLT3 confusable differs only by drug identity.

qualifier: prostanoid and leukotriene receptors via PLC-IP3 calcium
name: Prostanoid and leukotriene GPCR signaling via PLC-calcium
rationale: Members cover prostanoid and leukotriene receptors and PLC-coupled IP3/calcium GPCR signaling, unlike confusables on S1P/G-beta-gamma, leukotriene synthesis or histamine/purinergic receptors.

qualifier: CNS and PNS myelination, axon caliber and reactive gliosis
name: Myelin formation and maintenance, axon caliber and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members concern Schwann cell and oligodendrocyte myelin formation/maintenance, axon diameter and neurofilaments, and astrocyte reactive gliosis/migration, unlike confusables on axon regeneration, nodal organization or glial fate specification.

qualifier: hindbrain branchiomotor neuron migration
name: Hindbrain branchiomotor neuron migration and cranial nerve development
rationale: All members concern branchiomotor neuron migration and axon guidance in the hindbrain and facial/trigeminal nerve development, unlike confusables on sensory/olfactory/otic structures or general brainstem maturation.
